c10-birthday-october.observed_description: The year planner with a small pink birthday-cake drawing with three candles inside box 10 and one pen loop around box 10. Every box number is unchanged; nothing is written on or beside the cake.
c10-birthday-october.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). One loop and one cake, both in box 10; no words.
